purpose: Source-linked applicability inventory for research planning. This 2026-11-15 snapshot adds the Euro NCAP passenger-car 2026-2028 rating cycle. Not legal advice, certification, or a complete interpretation of any standard.

status_legend.CURRENT_PUBLISHED: Publisher or issuing authority identifies this as a published/current edition at snapshot date.
status_legend.CURRENT_WITH_AMENDMENTS: Use the base edition together with the listed applicable addenda/amendments/TIAs.
status_legend.DRAFT_OR_ENQUIRY: Not a published final amendment; do not treat as normative requirement.
status_legend.SNAPSHOT_GUIDANCE: Current protocol/guidance snapshot; re-check before every comparison.
status_legend.VERIFY_LOCALLY: Edition, adoption, amendment, jurisdiction or applicability needs confirmation from the competent local authority or official catalogue.
status_legend.CONTEXT_ONLY: Exposure/context evidence; not a product test or certification.

entries.scope: Ballistic resistance of human torso body armour; do not generalize to limb, accessory, animal or other unqualified form factors.
entries.interpretation_limit: Use with NIJ 0123.00 threat specification and applicable addenda. NIJ compliance status is specific to exact listed models/configurations.

entries.scope: Ballistic protection level and associated test-threat specification used with applicable equipment test standards.
entries.interpretation_limit: Threat specification is not by itself a product pass or certification.

entries.scope: Stab resistance of personal body armour.
entries.interpretation_limit: Confirm current NIJ compliance programme status and exact product class before claiming current qualification.

amendments: Amendment 1 was in draft/enquiry at snapshot date; not a final published amendment.
entries.scope: Evaluation of complete garments/ensembles using an instrumented manikin under defined flame/heat exposures.
entries.interpretation_limit: Results apply to the tested garment and exposure conditions; not a universal arc-flash or high-radiant heat test.

entries.scope: Structural/proximity firefighting protective ensembles and related equipment, subject to exact scope and applicable TIAs.
entries.interpretation_limit: Verify current TIAs, product scope and certification programme requirements.

entries.scope: Selection, care and maintenance of structural/proximity firefighting ensembles and open-circuit SCBA.
entries.interpretation_limit: Care/maintenance standard; not a substitute for product performance testing.

entries.scope: Drop-weight impact damage resistance of multidirectional continuous-fibre polymer-matrix composite laminated plates.
entries.interpretation_limit: Coupon screening/damage resistance only; not complete armour, vehicle, building or assembly qualification.

entries.scope: Crashworthiness and crash-avoidance evaluation protocols/rating criteria.
entries.interpretation_limit: Match vehicle class, weight, body style, model year, trim and protocol version; a rating is not approval of an aftermarket modification.

entries.publisher: US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
entries.scope: Vehicle consumer safety assessment including frontal, side, rollover and updated pedestrian-protection assessment paths.
entries.interpretation_limit: NCAP consumer ratings and FMVSS legal compliance are distinct; confirm exact market and model year.

entries.publisher: International Code Council / National Storm Shelter Association
entries.scope: Design and construction of storm shelters.
entries.interpretation_limit: Shelter-specific standard; adoption and local enforceability vary by jurisdiction.

entries.scope: Guidance for safe rooms for tornadoes and hurricanes.
entries.interpretation_limit: US hazard/standards context; not a South African building approval or universal building code.

entries.scope: Ignitability of products exposed to direct impingement of a single small flame.
entries.interpretation_limit: Small-flame ignitability only; does not prove whole-assembly fire resistance.

entries.scope: Comparative surface burning characteristics of building materials.
entries.interpretation_limit: Not a full wall/roof assembly fire-resistance test.

entries.scope: Thermal environmental conditions for human occupancy.
entries.interpretation_limit: Comfort assessment requires both environmental and occupant factors; do not reduce it to air temperature alone.

entries.scope: Minimum mechanical/natural ventilation and other IAQ requirements in nontransient residential dwelling units.
entries.interpretation_limit: Meeting requirements does not necessarily guarantee acceptable IAQ in all real operating conditions; thermal comfort is outside this standard's scope.

entries.publisher: South African Bureau of Standards / local building-control authorities
entries.edition: To be confirmed per applicable part and project jurisdiction.
amendments: Check active SABS catalogue, referenced standards, amendments and local authority adoption before project use.
entries.scope: South African National Building Regulations and applicable deemed-to-satisfy provisions.
entries.interpretation_limit: Do not infer a current edition or compliance from a secondary web listing; professional review and local authority confirmation required.

entries.publisher: Council for Scientific and Industrial Research
entries.edition: Municipal/settlement adaptation profiles; retrieve exact dataset and vintage per site.
entries.scope: South African settlement/municipal climate-risk context and adaptation planning.
entries.interpretation_limit: Contextual hazard evidence; not a building product test, design approval or certification.

amendments: Stage-specific test protocols and technical bulletins must be individually version-bound; see EURO_NCAP_2026_2028_CROSSWALK_2026_11_15.json.
entries.scope: Passenger-car safety assessment across Safe Driving, Crash Avoidance, Crash Protection and Post-Crash Safety.
entries.interpretation_limit: Four 100-point stage scores and year-specific balance thresholds govern star eligibility; 20/20/50/10 weights are for Best-in-Class ranking only. Applicability, equipment fitment, market area, exact test protocols and backstops must be checked. A consumer rating is not approval of an aftermarket modification.
